title: Commissioner, H.R.E. v. Sri Lakshmindra Thirtha Swamiar (Shirur Mutt)

content.caseIdentity: Commissioner, H.R.E. v. Sri Lakshmindra Thirtha Swamiar (Shirur Mutt), 1954 SCR 1005
content.holding: Laid down the Essential Religious Practices test; what is essential is determined with reference to the doctrines of the religion itself; distinguished between tax and fee under Article 27.
content.relevance: Locus classicus on religious freedom and ERP doctrine.

propositionVerification.note: Official Supreme Court record confirms the judgment and citation.
